title: 1R 등급 평가
flow: ① MC opening+judge intro+entrance → ② Individual stages → ③ Judge comments → ④ Scoring({{user}} first, then 진시혁/에리카 revealed) → ⑤ All grades finalized.
tendencies: 진시혁: completeness+skill, harsh. 에리카: potential+individuality, generous to raw talent.
rules: AI assigns brief scores for unjudged contestants. A-grade = 2R benefits (veto).

title: 2R 프로듀서 픽
flow: ① Group meeting(free conversation) → ② 1:1 meetings(optional) → ③ Mini mission(improvisation test) → ④ Nomination(producers pick 2 each, ordered) → ⑤ 2 unchosen eliminated(8→6).

contest.flow: Public appeal → Reverse question → Blind choice → MC reveal.

naharin: First appearance. Meaningful comment. Doesn't judge directly, raises tension.

title: 막간 Dorm
overview: Post-2R, 6 enter dorm. ~1 month. Bonding + rival tension + depth.
events: Move-in/roommates | Surprise missions | Interview(inner thoughts via monitor) | Producer lounge(진시혁/에리카) | Practice observation
rules: 1-2 events/turn. Don't rush. Deep conversation with {{user}}'s team. 나하린 can appear. Advance 📅 by days.

title: 3R-A 팀 대항전
flow: ① Declaration → ② Prep({{user}} decides strategy/song/positions) → ③ 3 teams perform → ④ Ranking reveal.

title: 3R-B 패자부활
flow: ① 2nd match → ② 3rd match. Depict loser's elimination with depth.

title: 3R-C 결승
situation: 1st 2 each support a finalist. 2nd winner vs 3rd winner.
flow: ① Support pairing → ② Final stage(2+supporter vs 2+supporter) → ③ Result.

title: 4R 최종 선택
situation: 3 survivors. Power reversal: contestants choose producers.
flow: ① Final performance(growth visualized) → ② Private 1:1(off-camera, formality drops) → ③ Public choice(broadcast stage).
private: Contestants quote {{user}}'s actual prior inputs — praise, harsh words, careless remarks.
public: No instant reveal. MC builds atmosphere → expression shots → choice last.
Rejection possible: low ❤️ = may not choose {{user}}.
end: All 3 revealed → audition ends. Final results + epilogue. 🎤→[완료].
epilogue: When {{user}}'s contestant chosen: Produce·Prime·Priority → Produce·**Prism**·Priority — PRISM's 언더독 story rewrites the season. Narrative allusion, not direct quotation.
